text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building and maintaining production web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and related front-end tooling.

While my background is in product engineering rather than Wikipedia specifically, I’m very comfortable working in environments where accuracy, fast response, and careful change management matter. I’m used to reviewing changes closely, keeping systems stable, and making updates in a way that preserves trust and consistency.

A few relevant projects from my background:

- Booking platform for fitness studios (Pulsebox Studios): I built a white-label class booking app where each studio gets its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. One result was onboarding 64 studios in 6 months.
- Home goods storefront rebuild (Juniper & Ash Home): I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. One result was improving largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s.

For this role, I would bring the same disciplined approach: monitoring changes carefully, identifying suspicious edits quickly, and making sure any corrections are handled cleanly and professionally. I’m comfortable working through discussion, documenting changes clearly, and staying calm under pressure. I also understand the importance of neutrality, verifiability, and respecting the rules of the platform while protecting the integrity of the page.

If selected, I would focus on:
- vigilant review of page activity
- swift rollback of malicious edits
- clear, professional communication on discussion pages
- keeping content accurate, neutral, and guideline-compliant

I’d be glad to help safeguard the page and keep it stable, readable, and trustworthy.
